markdownDescription:
## Ad Localizer Studio

One finished ad becomes the same ad in two more languages and two more shapes. Every word is translated in place — same layout, same typography, brand names untouched — and the story and banner are recomposed for their frames, not stretched.

1. **Your ad** — the finished creative with its text on it, in any language.
2. **Language 1 and Language 2** — type any language. Change them and rerun.
3. **Two translations** — for each language an AI reads every text on the ad and writes a replacement sheet: this text becomes that text, brand names stay.
4. **Two localized ads** — the ad with its text swapped per sheet, nothing else touched.
5. **Story and Banner** — the original ad recomposed for a 9:16 and a 16:9 frame. For a translated story or banner, wire a localized ad into the reference instead of the source.

data.label: Translation 1
data.userInput: Language: {Language 1 || French}. Write the replacement sheet for the ad in the reference image.
data.systemPrompt: You are a professional advertising translator preparing an ad for another market. Look at the reference ad image and list every piece of text on it — headline, sub-line, offer, button, small print, everything except brand names and logos — then give its translation into the requested language as a replacement sheet an image editor follows line by line. One item per line, biggest text first, exactly in this form: Replace "<original text, exactly as written>" with "<translation>". Keep brand names, product names, logos, numbers, prices, currency, URLs and legal identifiers unchanged, and end the sheet with one line that begins with the words Keep unchanged: followed by that list. Match the register of the original and keep each translation about as long as the original so it fits the same space. Output only the sheet, no commentary.
